title: person.status_changed.v1
description: Published when an employment status change takes effect (not when a future-dated change is merely recorded). `leave` is masked: it is published as `active`, and a change between `active` and `leave` publishes no event, because leave can reveal health or family circumstances; consumers that need it must read the directory as hr. Delivered at least once; consumers de-duplicate on `id`. The payload carries opaque ids and machine values only, never names, contact data or free text (SPEC.md sections 3.7 and 4.3).

id.description: Unique event id, stable across redeliveries.

effective_date.description: The date the change takes effect; access and vesting follow this date, not the event time.
